exam.scoringNotice: The 100–900 score is **an estimate produced by this app**, not a prediction. CompTIA does not publish its scaling: the real exam weights items by difficulty, so an official {{passing}} corresponds to no fixed percentage. Here the mapping is linear — 0% gives 100, 100% gives 900 — which puts the {{passing}} threshold at 81.25% correct. The number to trust is the raw score.
